slices.focus: Summer review reveals four straight quarters under spoilage target on core lanes with the strongest pantry group also above the on-time fresh-arrival threshold, validating the scheduled-lane model as a repeatable system rather than a lucky season.
slices.summary: Four consecutive quarters of sustained improvement under target, with correlated on-time arrival data, provide Eric the first tangible evidence that the system can improve through procedure and partnership rather than personal heroic rescue.
